title: introduce-invocation-annotator-and-latency-quantizer
author: Ava Thompson
description: Adds an invocation annotator service and a latency quantizer used by alerting and dashboards. Motivation: long-tail latency and token-cost alerts keep firing for noisy cohorts where contextual factors (model stage, kv-cache hit hint, prefix length) explain variance; existing rollups lack compact per-invocation annotations that downstream dashboards, SLOs and alerting can consume. This PR introduces: 1) a lightweight Invocation Annotator that attaches compact tags to traces at ingress (model_stage, kv_hint, prompt_shape_bucket, estimated_token_budget); 2) a latency quantizer service that computes per-invocation latency class (cold/warm/hot/stream-bound) and a normalized latency score for cohort-level smoothing; 3) upstream instrumentation to emit enriched metrics and labels (invocation.latency_score, invocation.latency_class, invocation.annotation_version) and a new compact dashboard panel (Invocation Context Matrix) that correlates token cost, latency_class and kv_hint; 4) alert attenuation rules that reduce noise by auto-silencing alerts for cohorts with stable high-latency baseline and known kv-cache coldness for a configurable window. Implementation notes: annotator implemented as an edge middleware in proxy/router with a small ranking function to avoid blocking critical paths; quantizer runs as a sidecar-like service in Observability namespace and consumes sampled spans via internal telemetry bus; added unit and integration tests for annotation schema and quantizer thresholds; added migration to tag historical rollups with annotation_version=1 for backward compatibility. Rollout plan: staged canary on 10% of traffic for 48h, monitor invocation.latency_score distribution and token_cost.slo breaches, ramp to 100% after acceptance criteria. Related: links to ENG-4921 design doc and SUP-2123 incident notes for noisy tenant.

review_comments: Diego Marquez: The annotator adds a small CPU cost at the router. Can we bound latency impact? Please add a microbenchmark and a p99 router latency regression guard.
Priya Nair: Quantizer thresholds look reasonable but we should surface a per-tenant override for the silence window. Also add a short description of how this interacts with canary fallbacks.
Eleni Kostas: Dashboard looks good but the matrix needs an explanation of the prompt_shape_bucket categories. Suggest renaming kv_hint->kv_cache_hint for clarity.
author_responses: Ava Thompson: Added microbenchmarks under tests/benchmarks/router_annotator_bench.go and a CI check that fails if annotator p99 regression > 1ms compared to baseline.

merge_commit_message: Introduce invocation annotator and latency quantizer: adds trace annotations, enriched metrics, dashboard and alert attenuation rules
release_notes: Add invocation annotations (model_stage, kv_cache_hint, prompt_shape_bucket), a latency quantizer that normalizes latency into discrete classes, and an Invocation Context Matrix dashboard. New alert attenuation policy reduces noisy alerts for stable high-latency cohorts.
